snippet.title: Dungeons & Desserts | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Dungeons & Desserts
Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.
